item.description: Update to fuse-overlayfs 1.17 to fix CVE-2026-52791: privilege escalation via SUID/SGID bit preservation on file truncation. item.description: The `$_internalIndexKey` aggregation expression can be used by any authenticated user to crash a MongoDB server (mongod).
